The evidence suggests that Ethotoin may indirectly affect Scn3a, the gene encoding the voltage-gated sodium channel subunit, through a cascade of molecular interactions involving Scn7a. The observed relationship implies that Ethotoin could influence the activity of Scn3a via a pathway that involves Scn7a, potentially altering the electrical properties of neurons. The strength of the interaction, as indicated by the final score, supports the hypothesis that Ethotoin exerts a functional impact on Scn3a through this mechanism.
